claim: The published checksum-verified Dagu 2.18.2 and mise 2026.10.1 Linux release archives were extracted only into an owned isolated root. Native dagu version, all 23 tracked DAG validations (16 pass / 7 baseline-invalid historical archives), coordinator-enabled start-all with HTTP 200 and coordinator connection plus clean native exit/closed listeners, and mise --version/doctor with shims on PATH were observed. Only the independent new-WSL profile and install-plan pins move; the workstation/trading stack remains held at Dagu 2.16.6. Existing historical recovery/model receipts retain their bytes and scopes.
limitations: Isolated Linux x86_64 binary qualification only; no live host service/timer/config, system mise, destination WSL, model/provider/GPU or broker operation was changed or qualified.

All 23 tracked YAML DAGs were validated unchanged: 16 passed, including all four current DAGs; seven archived fixtures failed with entrypoint document must not define name. Verified Dagu 2.16.6 rejects the same seven, so these failures are retained pre-existing evidence.

The start-all smoke uses an empty owned DAG directory and no scheduled/job/model execution. Its coordinator is enabled as the repository template and upstream default require; shutdown logged one not registered service-registry update error while the native process returned 0 and both owned listeners closed.
Upstream make test and mise unit/E2E suites, installed-client route activation, real job retry/SIGKILL/reboot recovery and production data downgrade were not run.

No published advisory found applies to the selected versions; historical advisories exist, including one affecting old mise 2026.9.18. Dagu has no tag CHANGELOG. Release notes contain migration-relevant #2784, #2776 and #2858 storage changes; a 2604 existing-home rollback must restore a pre-upgrade DAGU_HOME plus the prior binary/unit/environment together. The trading stack stays held at 2.16.6.
Version output and checksum matching do not prove the full integration, deployed host, source-build reproducibility, dependency-tree security or model quality.

native_commands.output:
Simultaneously start the web UI server, scheduler, and optionally coordinator in a single command.

This convenience command combines the functionality of 'dagu server', 'dagu scheduler',
and optionally 'dagu coordinator' into a single process. The web UI provides the management
interface, the scheduler handles automated DAG-run execution based on defined schedules,
and the coordinator (when enabled) manages distributed task execution across workers.

The coordinator is enabled by default and can be disabled by setting coordinator.enabled=false
in the config file or DAGU_COORDINATOR_ENABLED=false as an environment variable.

Flags:
  --host string                     Host address to bind the web server to (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port int                        Port number for the web server to listen on (default: 8080)
  --dags string                     Path to the directory containing DAG definition files
  --coordinator.host string         Host address to bind the coordinator gRPC server to (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --coordinator.advertise string    Address to advertise in service registry (default: auto-detected hostname)
  --coordinator.port int            Port number for the coordinator gRPC server (default: 50055)
  --peer.cert-file string           Path to TLS certificate file for peer connections
  --peer.key-file string            Path to TLS key file for peer connections
  --peer.client-ca-file string      Path to CA certificate file for client verification (mTLS)
  --peer.insecure                   Use insecure connection (h2c) instead of TLS
  --peer.skip-tls-verify            Skip TLS certificate verification (insecure)

Example:
  # Default mode (coordinator enabled)
  dagu start-all

  # Disable coordinator
  DAGU_COORDINATOR_ENABLED=false dagu start-all

  # Distributed mode with coordinator on all interfaces
  dagu start-all --coordinator.host=0.0.0.0 --coordinator.port=50055

  # Production with both web and coordinator on all interfaces
  dagu start-all --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080 --coordinator.host=0.0.0.0

This process runs continuously in the foreground until terminated.

Usage:
  dagu start-all [flags]

Flags:
  -c, --config string                  Path to the configuration file (default: $HOME/.config/dagu/config.yaml)
  -A, --coordinator.advertise string   Address to advertise in service registry (default: auto-detected hostname)
  -H, --coordinator.host string        Coordinator gRPC server host (default: 127.0.0.1) (default "127.0.0.1")
  -P, --coordinator.port string        Coordinator gRPC server port (default: 50055) (default "50055")
      --cpu-profile                    Enable CPU profiling (saves to cpu.pprof)
  -d, --dags string                    Directory containing DAG files (default: $HOME/.config/dagu/dags)
      --dagu-home string               Override DAGU_HOME for this command
  -h, --help                           help for start-all
  -s, --host string                    Server hostname or IP address (default: localhost) (default "localhost")
      --peer.cert-file string          Path to TLS certificate file for mutual TLS
      --peer.client-ca-file string     Path to CA certificate file for server verification
      --peer.insecure                  Use insecure connection (h2c) instead of TLS
      --peer.key-file string           Path to TLS key file for mutual TLS
      --peer.skip-tls-verify           Skip TLS certificate verification (insecure)
  -p, --port string                    Server port number (default: 8080) (default "8080")
  -q, --quiet                          Suppress output during dag-run

Global Flags:
      --context string   Context name to use for command execution (default: current context or local)

Validate a DAG YAML file without executing it.

Prints a human-readable result instead of structured logs.
Checks structural correctness and references (e.g., step dependencies)
similar to the server-side spec validation.

References whose value only exists during a run, such as ${context.paths.*}
or an environment variable supplied by the operator, are not reported by
default. Pass --show-unresolved to list them as well.

Usage:
  dagu validate [flags] <DAG definition>

Flags:
  -c, --config string      Path to the configuration file (default: $HOME/.config/dagu/config.yaml)
      --cpu-profile        Enable CPU profiling (saves to cpu.pprof)
      --dagu-home string   Override DAGU_HOME for this command
  -h, --help               help for validate
  -q, --quiet              Suppress output during dag-run
      --show-unresolved    Also report references whose value only exists during a run

Global Flags:
      --context string   Context name to use for command execution (default: current context or local)
